title: CISA KEV remediation deadline: MLflow SSRF (CVE-2026-64849)

summary: Amazon will permanently close Mechanical Turk, its 21-year-old crowdsourced task marketplace, along with SageMaker Ground Truth and Amazon Augmented AI, which closed to new customers on July 30; Amazon cited its own program assessment as AI training-data labeling has shifted to specialized vendors.
